name: When is the best time to consider new flooring for aging in place?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to consider new flooring for aging in place?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to consider new flooring for aging in place is proactively, before significant mobility challenges or safety concerns arise. If you or a loved one are beginning to experience minor balance issues, using mobility aids, or planning for long-term residency in the home, it's an opportune moment. Major home renovations, such as bathroom or kitchen remodels, also present an ideal time to integrate safe flooring choices throughout the relevant areas. Addressing flooring proactively can prevent accidents and support continued independence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider new flooring for aging in place proactively, before mobility issues arise, or during major home renovations to prevent future safety concerns.
